# VideoBlog Buddy: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 776402934a60 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Record your screen and camera, edit, and publish YouTube videos, Shorts and Reels about the apps you build. All in the browser; recordings never leave your computer.
**Live:** https://videoblog-buddy.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/videoblog-buddy · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `videoblog-buddy/.claude/skills/videoblogbuddy/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py videoblogbuddy` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms vs JavaScript.** Python Forms: Shell, Landing, Auth, Home (Studio), Planner, Apps, Extension, Prompter (no Shell,
  full screen), Profile, Admin + every list (Items/) and dialog (Dialogs/). The record, video and edit pages are whole
  JavaScript engine screens (theme/assets/vb-screens.js, the old pages moved unchanged) mounted by Components/Screen
  into a fresh element on show, destroyed on hide; those pages set `waits = True` and the screen sets UI_READY.
- **vb.py is the only door to the engines** (window.VB): `VB_BRIDGE` runs the engines' UI.api calls, `VB.host` gives them
  Python dialogs (toast, confirm, video_menu = Dialogs/VideoMenu -> Clips / delete). theme/assets/vb-kit.js is the shim
  with the old window.UI helpers the engines expect (UI.page/mountScreen, UI.modal for engine-only prompts, [data-go]).
- Engine files (unchanged from web/pages/_*.html): vb-core (VB helpers, vault = IndexedDB recordings, ext bridge,
  samples), vb-engine (player/render/export), vb-recorder (Recorder, Prompter, PiP), vb-templates, vb-words (captions),
  vb-youtube, vb-write, vb-sound, vb-studio (Look/LUTs + Frames). VB.heroPlayer (landing) is at the end of vb-screens.js.
- Recordings never reach the server: Home's storage/rescue cards and Dialogs/ManageFiles call VB.vault directly.
- Planner items get the page as item["host"] and call its methods; drag and drop is wired on the page element from
  data-id / data-col / data-ev / data-day attributes (Planner._wire_drag).
- state.set_me also sets window.UI.me (the engines read it). router.show sets window.UI._page (UI.current()).
- app.css is composed: old core.css + every old page's CSS (class names kept; `.ui-btn` rules aliased to Anvil Button
  roles) + the template role layer + a Forms section at the end. Engine screens still use the old `.ui-*` markup.
- Tests: tools/ui/smoke.js only (every address signed out / member / admin); drive.mjs runs Chrome with SwiftShader WebGL
  and fake camera/mic/screen. The browser extension (extension/) is unchanged; tools/build_extension.py zips it.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Biggest files (read these in parts)

`theme/assets/vb-screens.js` 2303, `theme/assets/app.css` 1360, `theme/assets/vb-engine.js` 1045, `theme/assets/vb-studio.js` 750, `anvil.yaml` 732, `theme/assets/vb-core.js` 587, `server_code/Studio.py` 512, `server_code/Clean.py` 367

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_extension.py`: Build the browser extension download: icons from assets/icon.svg + a zip the app serves.
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/store_assets.py`: Chrome Web Store images for the extension.
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
